trajectory_summary: This call opens neutrally and cooperatively but the rep, working off Google Maps satellite imagery, self-disqualifies the lead on tree coverage without exploring any other roof/shade nuance, without capturing a single verify item beyond address, and without asking the standard trimming/removal follow-up with any persistence. The call ends in under two minutes with no appointment and no attempt to salvage or route the lead elsewhere.
outcome_dispute: None likely disputed — this is a legitimate roof/shade DQ scenario, but the SPEED and lack of qualifying rigor (no bill, no interest reason, no utility, single trimming question then immediate give-up) suggest the rep treated a soft visual read as a hard gate faster than the schema calls for.
